Interesting flavours in the food.
Mar 2024 • Couples
We enjoyed the fresh clean taste of the 3 dishes we shared between 2 adults.. Our favourite was the Special Smoked Duck Rice. It was a deconstructed dish with rice on the bottom, the shredded vegetables piled around the side of the bowl, topped with a fried egg and then slices of smoked duck. You receive a bowl of sauce to mix through the whole dish. We have never tasted anything quite like it. Highly recommend it for originality of flavour. We enjoyed the deep fried chicken Bao and the smoked bacon and chorizo Bao. The home brewed ginger beer was not to our taste.
